title: The Repair Café
transcript: A repair café will open this Saturday at the North Street Library. Instead of paying for repairs, visitors can bring one broken household item and work with a volunteer to fix it. The first event will focus on small electrical items, such as lamps and radios. People should arrive by two in the afternoon to register. The library hopes the café will help residents learn practical skills while keeping usable products out of the rubbish bin.

questions.prompt: How will visitors get their items repaired?
options: They will pay a technician in advance.
They will exchange them for working items.
They will work alongside a volunteer.
They will collect them the following week.
questions.answer: They will work alongside a volunteer.
questions.explanation: 听到 work with a volunteer to fix it，可知参与者和志愿者一起维修。

questions.prompt: What is one aim of the café?
options: To raise funds for the library.
questions.explanation: keeping usable products out of the rubbish bin 表示减少丢弃。
